scripts.migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pdf2zh-db --remote
scripts.d1:tables: npx wrangler d1 execute pdf2zh-db --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.test:retention: rm -rf .tmp/retention-test && tsc src/retention.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --outDir .tmp/retention-test --skipLibCheck && node --test tests/retention.test.cjs
scripts.test:public-fallback: rm -rf .tmp/public-fallback-test && tsc src/publicFallback.ts --target ES2022 --module commonjs --outDir .tmp/public-fallback-test --skipLibCheck && node --test tests/publicFallback.test.cjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:retention && npm run test:public-fallback
